description: TUNABLE visible set 7, authored 2026-10-10 by an independent agent without access to search results, eval output or ranking code. For candidate-generation research; may be tuned on. 70 paraphrase targets sampled with ORDER BY random() (bodies >=400 chars, non-code, credential/IP/hostname rows screened out): note 22, memory 10, quoxplan_note/stream/plan 16, commit 8, transcript_session 8, other (insight, finding, governance_incidents, tasks_execution_wisdom) 6. Every question passed Jaccard<=0.3 and <=50% content-word overlap against its note. 15 near-misses, each verified 0 rows via SQL LIKE on notes.body for the org with key terms: Apache Flink, Cassandra, Istio, Vagrant, CockroachDB, ClickHouse, Jaeger, Fly.io, Kubeflow, Terragrunt, Kustomize, Tekton, Renovate, Sidekiq, Airflow. Note: two governance_incidents questions share near-identical sibling notes (cross-listed in acceptable).
